items.info: Electrical Control Panel. BTRY switch. Before switching on, the battery test should read 24 VDC or more on AV and UTIL. HDDs 1 and 2, CNI-MU No. 1 and the gear position lights should illuminate.
items.label: Battery

items.info: Electrical Control Panel. All four GENERATOR switches on.
items.label: Generators

items.info: APU Panel. Check the APU fire handle is in and the APU area is clear. APU control switch to START, then RUN.
items.label: APU

items.info: Electrical Control Panel. Select APU once the APU is running. EXT PWR can be used instead if ground power is connected. It can be removed after the first engine is running.
items.label: EXT PWR/APU

items.info: FADEC/Propeller Control Panel. FADEC switches unguarded and NORM, PROPELLER CONTROL switches NORMAL, ATCS ON, PROP SYNC ON.
items.label: FADEC/Propeller Panel

items.info: Fire/Engine Start Panel. All FIRE handles in, ENGINE START switches at STOP.
items.label: Fire/Engine Start Panel

items.info: Bleed Air Panel. L and R ISO VALVE, DIVIDER VALVE and nacelle shutoff switches to AUTO.
items.label: Bleed Air Panel

items.info: Pressurization Panel. AUTO RATE knob NORM, EMER DEPRESS switch NORM, mode select AUTO. LDG/CONST ALT at or slightly above field elevation.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Ice Protection Panel. PROPELLERS OFF, ENG AUTO, WING/EMP AUTO, ANTI-ICE/DE-ICE to DE-ICE, PITOT and NESA HEAT OFF.
items.label: Ice Protection

items.info: Exterior Lighting Panel. NAVIGATION LIGHTS FLASH/BRIGHT, TOP STROBE RED, BOTTOM STROBE WHT, COVERT/FORMATION and LEDGE OFF.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: CNI-MU. Confirm the navaid database is current, enter the date, verify ALIGN POS and select AUTONAV.
items.label: EGIs

items.info: CNI-MU. Work through the pages in order: COMM TUNE radios on and frequencies set, NAV TUNE navaids set for departure, IFF (Mode S, C and 3 on, PWR ON STBY), ROUTE/LEGS (origin, destination, alternate, waypoints, then ACTIVATE and EXEC), PERF INIT (weight, climb, cruise, descent) and TOLD INIT (MC INDEX, weight and balance, V SPEEDS).
items.label: CNI-MU Preflight

items.info: AMU. PFD (MAG/True/Grid, RAD ALT, flight director source), NAV RADAR and digital map (range, center/offset, overlays), NAV SELECT (CDI source, PNTR 1 and 2, SHIP SOLN INAV) and GCAS AND STALL.
items.label: AMU Setup

items.info: REF/MODE Panel. HP, RAD ALT and MINS as required, FPA set, BARO SET set, flight director mode as required.
items.label: REF/MODE Panel

items.info: AMU PREFLIGHT page. Run SMOKE DETECTOR and FIRE DETECTION tests. MASTER WARNING illuminates, the warning tone sounds and the SMOKE, ENG 1-4 FIRE and APU FIRE ACAWS messages display then clear. The fire handles illuminate during the fire test.
items.label: Fire & Smoke Detectors

items.info: Hydraulic Panel. ANTI SKID ON, EMER BRAKE SEL to EMER, SUCTION BOOST PUMP switches ON, ENGINE PUMP switches ON, AUX PUMP ON. The aux pump goes off in the before takeoff brake check.
items.label: Hydraulic Panel

items.info: Prevents the aircraft from rolling during prep. With EMER BRAKE SEL at EMER, press the pedals and watch the emergency brake pressure indicator for a pressure drop.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Confirm the GEAR lever is down.
items.label: Gear Lever

items.info: Fuel Management Panel. DUMP switches closed and guarded. CROSS FEED, transfer TO, CROSS SHIP and INTERCONNECT switches closed, transfer FROM switches off. Check fuel quantity and balance are within limits.
items.label: Fuel

items.info: Bleed Air Panel. APU bleed air valve open. It closes again in the before taxi flow.
items.label: APU Bleed Air

items.info: Uncage and set the standby attitude indicator. The power-off flag should clear and the gyro should stay stable.
items.label: Standby Attitude

items.info: Run the oxygen mask setup and check the LOX quantity, then leave oxygen off.
items.label: Oxygen

items.info: Throttle Quadrant. Power levers at GND IDLE.
items.label: Power Levers

items.info: Nose landing gear pin and chocks removed and stowed. The pin is stowed near the galley.
items.label: NLG Pin & Chocks

items.info: Throttle Quadrant. LOW SPD GND IDLE buttons. Starting in low speed ground idle warms the engine components gradually.
items.label: LSGI

items.info: Fire/Engine Start Panel. ENGINE START switch to START until the white box appears, then RUN. Monitor the engine instruments. Stop the start if there is no NG within 10 seconds, or no oil pressure within 15 seconds of NG rotation.
items.label: Engine 3

items.info: Fire/Engine Start Panel. Start 4, then 2, then 1 the same way. The normal order is 3, 4, 2, 1.
items.label: Engines 4-2-1

items.info: Engine Status and System Status displays. Check the engine indications and ACAWS messages for all four engines.
items.label: Engine & System Status

items.info: Bleed Air Panel. APU bleed air valve closed before taxi.
items.label: APU Bleed Air

items.info: Ice Protection Panel. ENG switch ON for 30 seconds and check ENG A/I ON displays, then AUTO. For the boots, ANTI-ICE/DE-ICE to ANTI-ICE, then back to DE-ICE after 2 seconds. WING/EMP A/I TEST displays and clears after 90 seconds.
items.label: Ice Protection

items.info: AMU GCAS AND STALL page. With the power levers in the ground range, select PUSHER TEST.
items.label: Stall Warning & Pusher

items.info: Engage each autopilot, move the pitch and roll controls, then disconnect with the control wheel button.
items.label: AFCS

items.info: Check full travel of the elevator, ailerons and rudder.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Radar Panel. Set the mode for departure.
items.label: Radar

items.info: REF/MODE Panel BARO SET. Both pilots state the setting, and the pilot also states the standby altimeter setting.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Landing Lights Panel. TAXI LIGHTS and WINGTIP TAXI LIGHTS on before taxi. Check the taxi path is clear. Control taxi speed with LSGI and reverse rather than the brakes.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Hydraulic Panel EMER BRAKE SEL. Check the emergency brakes, select NORMAL, check the normal brakes, then AUX PUMP OFF.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Flaps Lever. Cycle to 0% (rudder boost drops) and 100% (rudder pressure rises), then set 50%. Check for automatic trimming.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Aileron and rudder trim zero, elevator trim set for takeoff, ELEV TAB switch NORM.
items.label: Trim

items.info: HUD. Heading tracks correctly, radar altimeter reads between -3 and 1 ft, and the lateral guidance mode is correct for departure.
items.label: Instruments

items.info: Throttle Quadrant. Ground idle switches to high speed. Can be selected any time after engine start.
items.label: High-Speed Ground Idle

items.info: Exterior Lighting Panel. TOP and BOTTOM STROBE WHT, NAVIGATION LIGHTS STEADY as required.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: Ice Protection Panel. PITOT and NESA HEAT switches on.
items.label: Pitot & NESA Heat

items.info: Landing Lights Panel.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Electrical Control Panel EXT PWR/APU switch OFF, then APU Panel APU control switch STOP.
items.label: APU

items.info: CNI-MU IFF page. On and transmitting. TCAS to TA/RA.
items.label: IFF

items.info: AMU PREFLIGHT page, PROP OVRSPD GVNR. Aircraft stationary with all four engines running. Power levers to FLT IDLE, then select engines 1 to 4.
items.label: Prop Overspeed Governor

items.info: Throttle Quadrant. Advance to TAKEOFF. Power is set when within 200 HP of predicted takeoff power, no later than 5 seconds after setting.
items.label: Power Levers

items.info: Release once takeoff power is set. A rolling takeoff is allowed if power reaches within 200 HP of predicted within 5 seconds.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Steer with the nosewheel first, then change to rudder once it is effective, around 50 to 70 knots and no later than 5 knots before rotation.
items.label: Nosewheel Steering

items.info: Rotate smoothly to the target pitch attitude and let the aircraft accelerate above VOBS.
items.label: Rotate

items.info: Gear Lever. Raise with a positive rate of climb. The gear indicator and handle lights go out.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Flaps Lever. Under 100,000 lb, raise the flaps passing 135 KIAS. At higher weights, start at 135 KIAS or VOBS + 5 and finish at VOBS + 25. The flap indicator should show up.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Throttle Quadrant. Reduce to maximum continuous once the flaps are up.
items.label: Power Levers

items.info: Landing Lights Panel. Landing lights retracted and off, TAXI LIGHTS off, WINGTIP TAXI LIGHTS as required.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Engage once the flaps are up and flight director guidance is set. On the REF/MODE Panel, IAS gives speed control and vertical guidance, NAV gives lateral guidance along the flight plan.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: REF/MODE Panel BARO SET. Set standard passing the transition altitude.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Throttle Quadrant. Set power from the calculated cruise data.
items.label: Cruise Power

items.info: Fuel Management Panel. Keep fuel balance within limits. Use auxiliary and external tank fuel before main tank fuel.
items.label: Fuel Balance

items.info: Pressurization Panel. Set the mode select switch, AUTO RATE knob and LDG/CONST ALT, then state the settings.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: REF/MODE Panel. RAD ALT 50 ft below HAT for a precision approach, 250 ft non-precision, 300 ft circling or visual. Set FPA, and MINS to the published minimums.
items.label: REF/MODE Panel

items.info: CNI-MU. Update ROUTE/LEGS, enter TOLD INIT from the destination ATIS, check landing speeds and distances, then review MC INDEX, V SPEEDS and INDEX. Enter the published missed approach before starting the approach.
items.label: CNI-MU Approach

items.info: AMU NAV SELECT page. CDI SOURCE to the approach navaid, PNTR 1 and PNTR 2 as required, COURSE knob set. Set the HDDs, NAV RADAR overlays and digital map for the approach. Both pilots state the CDI source and course.
items.label: NAV Select

items.info: Brief once both in-range flows are done, then run the in-range checklist.
items.label: Approach Briefing

items.info: Throttle Quadrant. FLT IDLE with the gear and flaps up.
items.label: Power Levers

items.info: Descend at maximum lift over drag speed down to 20,000 ft, then hold 250 KIAS below 20,000 ft.
items.label: Descent Speed

items.info: REF/MODE Panel BARO SET. Set the local setting passing the transition level. Both pilots state it, and the pilot also states the standby altimeter setting.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Fuel Management Panel. Tank-to-engine is the recommended setup for approach and landing. Check fuel quantity and distribution, and turn SPR DRAIN on if required.
items.label: Fuel Management

items.info: Flaps Lever. Select 50% and confirm the indicator reads 50% before the before landing checklist.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Gear Lever. Confirm three down and centered.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Landing Lights Panel. Landing lights extended and on as required, TAXI LIGHTS on, WINGTIP TAXI LIGHTS as required.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Flaps Lever. 100% is the recommended landing flap and can be selected any time after the turn to final. On a coupled ILS, extend from 50% to 100% before or after glideslope intercept, not at it. Doing it at intercept can overload the elevator servo and disconnect the autopilot.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Disconnect before 200 ft AGL on a CAT I ILS (100 ft for CAT II), or before descending below MDA on a non-precision approach. Disconnect the autothrottles no later than crossing the runway threshold.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Throttle Quadrant. FLT IDLE for touchdown. Move below flight idle only with all three gear on the ground and below 145 KTAS.
items.label: Power Levers

items.info: Throttle Quadrant. Pause at GND IDLE and check for four BETA (B) indications on the HP gauges, then move toward MAX REV. A missing B means a possible directional control problem.
items.label: Reverse

items.info: Apply anti-skid braking once all gear are on the ground. On a long runway, use reverse and light braking to reduce brake wear. Hand the control wheel to the copilot and use nosewheel steering as needed.
items.label: Brakes & Anti-Skid

items.info: Ice Protection Panel. Start the after landing flow below 20 knots. PROPELLERS OFF, ENG AUTO, WING/EMP AUTO, ANTI-ICE/DE-ICE to DE-ICE, PITOT and NESA HEAT OFF.
items.label: Ice Protection

items.info: APU Panel. APU control switch START, then RUN. Electrical Control Panel EXT PWR/APU switch to APU.
items.label: APU

items.info: Exterior Lighting Panel. BOTTOM STROBE WHT, NAVIGATION LIGHTS FLASH as required.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: Flaps Lever.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Nosewheel centered, then set the parking brake.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Throttle Quadrant. GND IDLE with low speed ground idle selected.
items.label: Power Levers

items.info: Fire/Engine Start Panel. All four ENGINE START switches to STOP.
items.label: Engine Start Switches

items.info: FADEC/Propeller Control Panel. PROPELLER CONTROL switches to FEATHER.
items.label: Propeller Control

items.info: Hydraulic Panel. ENGINE PUMP switches ON, SUCTION BOOST PUMP switches OFF, EMER BRAKE SEL to EMER, AUX PUMP OFF.
items.label: Hydraulic Panel

items.info: Cage the standby attitude indicator.
items.label: Standby Attitude

items.info: Crew oxygen off.
items.label: Oxygen

items.info: Wheel chocks installed.
items.label: Chocks

description: Four-engine turboprop transport. One simmer covers the pilot, copilot and crew chief flows, from power-up to shutdown.
